content:
I need you to deeply analyze the OLD Nexus Brain wiki system at `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/` to understand what was attempted before:

1. Read `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/CLAUDE.md` and `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/START_HERE.md`
2. Read `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/NEXUS_LLM_WIKI.md` and `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/NEXUS_LLM_WIKI_PHASE2.md`
3. List the full directory tree of `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/nexus_vault/` (if it exists)
4. Read any AGENTS.md or system files inside nexus_vault
5. List `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/Nexus_Brain/` subdirectories and read key index files
6. Check `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/brain/` contents
7. Read `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/Nexus_Brain_Prompt.md`
8. Check `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/Phase2_DeepDive/` contents

Also, read the RAG/query system files:
- `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/nexus_vault/planner.py` (if exists)
- `/sdcard/Nexus_Brain/rag/query.py` (if exists)
- Any master files or term files in the old system

Report everything: file paths, sizes, formats, what worked, what didn't, and how the old system structured knowledge vs the new NEXUS_LLM_WIKI approach.
